channel.title: SSMConnect blog
channel.description: Connecting to AWS servers over Systems Manager, copying files between them, and SSMConnect release notes.

item.title: How to copy files between EC2 servers when port 22 is closed
item.description: Four ways to move files from one EC2 server to another when SSH is closed and you only have AWS Systems Manager: S3, manual port forwarding, rsync, and a two-pane window in SSMConnect.

item.title: What is new in SSMConnect 2.0: connections that stay open and a calmer dashboard
item.description: A tour of SSMConnect 2.0 to 2.0.5 for Windows: connect-all with keep-alive, login checks before PuTTY opens, usage bars, a file window that matches the dashboard, and a scrolling grid for large fleets.

item.title: Is it safe to copy files between servers through your PC?
item.description: How SSMConnect's file transfer is built: SSH inside the SSM tunnel, streaming through memory, no root, a private sudo helper, and the limits you should know about.

item.title: SSM port forwarding explained for developers
item.description: What AWS Systems Manager port forwarding does, why your tools connect to 127.0.0.1, and how one tunnel per server lets PuTTY, WinSCP and Remote Desktop work with no open ports.
